title: Research
text:
When Reminders Fail to Eliminate Age Differences in Prospective Memory with Ellis, D., Dupre, C. and Ball, H. - under review [PDF] [Code]

Prospective memory (PM) offloading – setting reminders to support future intentions – can help older adults mitigate age-related memory declines. However, prior research suggests they may not always fully benefit from available reminders. This study examined metacognitive factors influence age differences in PM offloading across three within-subjects conditions: forced internal (reminders set for no PM targets), forced external (reminders set for all PM targets), and choice (target-by-target reminder setting).

My Website How to Rebuild the Site
This website is creating using RStudio Quarto. The zephyr theme is used for a professional look. The navigation bar includes github and email links connecting to my content in different areas. There are multiple tabs that show the different areas of my work including my CV, assignments, current research, and teaching experiences. The front home page gives a short description of my research interests and my academic standing. To build the website, one must…

Open RStudio
New Project
New Directory
Add Repository from local file C:- The University of Texas at Dallas.github.io

Edit quarto.yml to look like this
project:
type: website
output-dir: docs

description: "One line about your research"

Wait and see if everything loads properly. Check your website https (make sure it is not local host) and check every page to see if its correct.]
